arabic_anchors: والنون والألف مفعول أول. والصِّراطَ مفعول ثان
evidence.quran_alignment: Read complete AR/TR/EN and 1:4-7 context. Canonical 1:6 is ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ. Although the frozen source opens إِنَّا هُدْنا, its own analysis specifies supplication, deletion of ya, connecting alif from يهدي, na as first object and al-sirat as second, and al-mustaqim as its adjective. These combined details decisively identify ihdina of 1:6. The anomalous heading does not establish a different substantive verse target.
evidence.translation_alignment: Turkish starts (اهْدِنَا) and follows every grammatical statement to al-mustaqim. English preserves the anomalous printed heading with a transcription-error note and follows the same complete analysis. Both match this Arabic entry at the mapping level.
evidence.excluded_as_extra_targets: The dialectal discussion of al-sirat and general sin/sad conditioning remains explanation of the verse's path-word, not a separate introductory unit.
